content: now this whole fan installation should imho be done before attaching the shroud to the toolhead, then install the shroud and fan together to the toolhead.

For me the hook doesn't seem to hold the wire very well.  I had to use a small screw driver to hold the wire under the hook and gently pull up on both ends to kind of tighten it up in there.  I did this after connecting the fan in the next step, but still not sure how well it's being held there.

replies.content: I created three loops to avoid too much cable coming out of the side. That also helps with the cable hook to hold the cable better
